user.title: Connect to SolisCloud
user.description: Choose cloud, a local data logger, or local first with SolisCloud as a fallback. Local discovery only works while the inverter is producing, because the stick is powered by the inverter and is off at night.

data_description.source: Cloud only, a local logger on your network, or local first with SolisCloud as a fallback. Local discovery only works while the inverter is producing.
data_description.api_url: Use the host that issued the key, including the port. The international service listens on port 13333. Leave this unused for a local-only setup.
data_description.key_id: The key id from SolisCloud API management. This is not the portal username. Leave it empty for local only.
data_description.key_secret: Shown once when the key is created. Stored in the config entry and redacted from diagnostics.

logger.title: Local logger
logger.description: Discovered Solarman loggers: {found}. Auto-detect tries port 502, then port 8899. A Solis register map on 502 is an S2-WL-ST only when port 80 names the Solis logger page. A gateway page is stored as a Modbus TCP gateway. If the page does not name the device, you choose, with S2-WL-ST pre-selected. S5-WiFi-ST is experimental: Solis does not officially support local access, and newer firmware closes port 502. The inverter must be producing. Reserve the address in the router.

data_description.logger_kind: Auto-detect probes port 502, then 8899. Port 502 is an S2-WL-ST only when the device web page says so. S5-WiFi-ST is experimental: Solis does not officially support local access, and a firmware update often closes port 502. Modbus RTU over TCP is experimental and uses the gateway model for its factory port.
data_description.logger_host: Current address. Reserve a stick in the router. A Solarman stick is found again by serial. An S2-WL-ST, S5 and a gateway are not. 10.10.100.254 is the setup address of a stick or an Elfin, not the address on the house LAN.
data_description.logger_port: Leave empty for 502 on an S2, S5 or Modbus TCP gateway. For RTU over TCP, leave empty to use the gateway model: 8899 Elfin, 4196 Waveshare, 26 USR RS485, 6638 ESPHome. A typed port always wins. 23 is the USR RS232 socket.
data_description.logger_serial: Solarman: the numeric serial from the label or from discovery. S2 and S5: the serial in the Wi-Fi name D_ or Solis_, not the inverter serial. Gateway and RTU: any label you choose, or leave empty to use the inverter serial.
data_description.slave_id: Leave empty to try slave 1, then 2, then 3. The Solis default is 1.
data_description.inverter_serial: Optional. The SolisCloud inverter serial, for example 110E40182280017. Leave empty to read it from the stick when that range answers, or from SolisCloud in local-and-cloud mode. This is the entity id. On an S2-WL-ST it is also the config unique id when the stick serial is empty.
data_description.logger_preset: Used only for Modbus RTU over TCP, and only when Port is empty. Elfin EW11/EE11 leave the factory on 8899. Waveshare RS485 TO ETH listens on 4196 until you change it. USR-TCP232 uses 26 on the RS485 socket and 23 on the RS232 socket. ESPHome's stream server commonly uses 6638.

logger_choice.title: Which device is on port 502?
logger_choice.description: {note} Solis documents Modbus TCP on the S2-WL-ST. A Waveshare, Elfin or USR in Modbus mode returns the same inverter registers. S5-WiFi-ST is not offered here: it is experimental and newer firmware closes port 502.

data_description.logger_kind: S2-WL-ST if this is the Solis stick. Modbus TCP gateway if a Waveshare, Elfin or USR is doing the conversion.

stations.title: Choose plants
stations.description: Select the SolisCloud plants this entry should follow.

data_description.station_ids: Only the selected plants are polled. Change the set later with reconfigure.

reauth_confirm.title: Refresh SolisCloud credentials
reauth_confirm.description: The API key was rejected. Enter a current key id and secret.

data_description.key_id: The key id from SolisCloud API management. This is not the portal username.
data_description.key_secret: Shown once when the key is created. Stored in the config entry and redacted from diagnostics.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Solis
reconfigure.description: Update the API host, the plants to follow, and how often to poll.

data_description.time_zone: Leave empty to follow Home Assistant when it is within an hour of the plant offset. Use an IANA name such as Europe/London to force one, or plant to keep the numeric offset from Solis.
data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between polls. Cloud samples arrive about every five minutes, so a cloud-only entry stays at 60 or slower (default 300). A local logger defaults to 60 and cannot be faster than 30.
data_description.request_timeout: Seconds to wait for one HTTP call. Default 30.
data_description.endpoint_interval: Minimum seconds between calls to the same API path. Default 2, which stays under the published limit of two calls per second.
data_description.source: Cloud only, local only, or local with SolisCloud fallback.
data_description.logger_kind: Auto-detect, Solarman V5, Solis S2-WL-ST, a Modbus TCP gateway, experimental S5-WiFi-ST (Solis does not officially support local access; firmware often closes port 502), or experimental Modbus RTU over TCP. Changing this keeps the same entities.
data_description.logger_preset: Used only for Modbus RTU over TCP when Port is empty. Elfin factory port is 8899. Waveshare RS485 TO ETH is 4196. USR RS485 is 26. ESPHome stream server is commonly 6638.
data_description.logger_host: Current logger or gateway address. Leave empty to keep the saved address.
data_description.logger_port: Leave empty for the default port of the selected logger.
data_description.logger_serial: Logger serial or a label for a gateway. Fill this together with the IP to attach a stick to an existing cloud entry. For an S2-WL-ST or S5 this is the serial in the Wi-Fi name.
data_description.slave_id: Leave empty to try slave 1, then 2, then 3.
data_description.inverter_serial: Optional SolisCloud inverter serial. Set it so local and cloud entities stay the same device.
data_description.api_url: Use the host that issued the key, including the port. The international service listens on port 13333.
data_description.station_ids: Only the selected plants are polled. Change the set later with reconfigure.

error.invalid_auth: SolisCloud rejected the API key id or secret.
error.invalid_timezone: Enter an IANA timezone such as Europe/London, or plant to keep the Solis offset.
error.clock_skew: SolisCloud rejected the request time. The clock must be within 15 minutes of UTC.
error.timeout: SolisCloud did not answer before the timeout.
error.no_stations: The account returned no plants. Check the API key and that the plant has an id.
error.logger_asleep: No route to the logger, or it timed out. At night the inverter powers the stick off. Try again while it is producing.
error.logger_busy: The logger reset or refused the local session. It can still be uploading to SolisCloud. Wait at least 10 seconds and try once. Do not retry in a tight loop.
error.logger_tcp_disabled: Port 502 is closed. The S2-WL-ST serves Modbus TCP from firmware 100101B4. Some later updates close the port, and enabling TCP on older firmware disconnects SolisCloud. Ask Solis for a build that keeps port 502 open, such as 100121cf or a 100141dx release, and enable Modbus in the stick or the SolisCloud app.
error.logger_modbus_silent: The stick accepted TCP on port 502 and sent no Modbus reply. It often allows only one client. On older firmware that client is SolisCloud or this integration, not both. Disconnect the other Modbus client, or ask Solis for firmware 100121cf, 100121d0 or 100141dx, which are reported to allow both.
error.logger_identity: This logger did not yield a stable id. Type the logger serial from the label or Wi-Fi name, or the inverter serial.
error.logger_gateway: Nothing accepted TCP on that address and port. Check the gateway IP and the port (502 for Modbus TCP, 8899 or 23 for a transparent tunnel). A gateway that is powered independently does not switch off with the inverter.
error.logger_wrong_protocol: The device accepted TCP and the bytes were not the framing you selected. Use Modbus TCP gateway when the device converts to Modbus TCP. Use Modbus RTU over TCP when it is a transparent serial tunnel. A value off by 256 usually means the other mode.
error.logger_wrong_slave: A Modbus reply came back from a different slave. The Solis default is 1. Set the slave that the inverter is using.
error.logger_unsupported_map: Modbus answered, and neither the Solis 3000 string map nor the 33000 hybrid map is present. This is not a Solis inverter on that slave, or the gateway is pointed at the wrong serial port.
error.logger_timeout: TCP connected and no Solis frame arrived. The inverter may be off, the baud may not be 9600 8N1, or a transparent gateway was given the Modbus TCP option. Try again while the inverter is producing.
error.logger_choice: Port 502 returned a Solis map and the web page did not name the device. In this form, set Logger to Solis S2-WL-ST or Modbus TCP gateway instead of Auto-detect.
error.invalid_logger: The port must be 1 to 65535, the slave 1 to 247, and a Solarman serial must be the number printed on the stick.

abort.already_configured: This API key is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach SolisCloud to load plants.
abort.not_solis_logger: That device is not a Solarman logger.
abort.logger_not_setup: No Solis entry is using this logger yet.
abort.wrong_account: That API key belongs to a different account.

invalid_auth.title: SolisCloud rejected the API key
invalid_auth.description: Update the key id and secret. Reads use the API key only; the portal password is not used.

clock_skew.title: Home Assistant clock is outside the SolisCloud window
clock_skew.description: SolisCloud refuses requests whose Date header is more than 15 minutes from UTC. Set the host clock and time zone, then reload Solis.

no_inverters.title: SolisCloud returned no inverters
no_inverters.description: The plant list or inverter list was empty. A plant without an id, or Solis error 'abnormal data', looks like this. The last successful inverter list is kept for a few polls.

abnormal_data.title: SolisCloud returned abnormal data
abnormal_data.description: The platform answered with code 1 (often the Chinese message for abnormal data). This is an account-side fault. Disabling and recreating the API key, or opening a Solis ticket, is what clears it.

legacy_control.title: Inverter control was not migrated
legacy_control.description: The previous Solis integration had the control API enabled. This version does not send /v2/api/control or /v2/api/atRead, because polling those calls has been reported to drop the data logger's cloud session. Battery schedules are unchanged on the inverter.

cloud_outage.title: SolisCloud is unreachable
cloud_outage.description: SolisCloud has been unreachable long enough that live readings are hidden, so an old power sample is not shown as current. Energy totals stay at the last good value and will not move backwards. This notice clears itself when a poll succeeds.

logger_locked.title: Local logger is pausing reads
logger_locked.description: The logger accepts a connection and then resets it. On a DLS-L this follows too many sessions or a read of a register the inverter does not have. On an S2-WL-ST the stick often allows one Modbus client, and firmware 1001318c can ignore port 502 for several minutes after a connection is closed. It usually clears within about 10 minutes or after the inverter is power-cycled. SolisCloud readings are used while a fresh cloud sample exists. The integration tries local again on its own, first after at least 10 seconds and then less often, up to about 10 minutes. A small morning power reading means the inverter is producing.

logger_tcp_disabled.title: S2-WL-ST Modbus TCP is disabled
logger_tcp_disabled.description: Port 502 is closed while the logger is on the network. Firmware before 100101B4 has no Modbus TCP. Some later updates close the port again, and the official setup note says enabling TCP can disconnect SolisCloud. Ask Solis for a firmware that keeps port 502 open and still uploads, such as 100121cf, 100121d0 or a 100141dx build. This notice clears when a local read succeeds.

logger_modbus_silent.title: S2-WL-ST accepted TCP and sent no Modbus
logger_modbus_silent.description: The socket opened and no register reply came back. The stick often allows one local connection. On older firmware SolisCloud holds that connection and local Modbus stays silent, which is the official 'enabling TCP disconnects SolisCloud' case in reverse. Stop the other Modbus client, or ask Solis for firmware that allows both (100121cf, 100121d0, 100141dx). An S5-WiFi-ST that still has port 502 open has the same limit. This notice clears when a local read succeeds.

logger_gateway.title: Modbus gateway is not accepting connections
logger_gateway.description: The address refused TCP or could not be reached. Check the IP, the port, and that the gateway is powered. Give the gateway a DHCP reservation so the address does not move. If it has moved, use Reconfigure on the Solis entry and type the new address. This is not the inverter switching a Solis stick off for the night. This notice clears when a local read succeeds.

logger_wrong_protocol.title: Logger framing does not match
logger_wrong_protocol.description: The socket opened and the bytes were not the framing stored for this entry. A Waveshare, Elfin or USR in transparent mode needs Modbus RTU over TCP. The same device in Modbus TCP conversion mode needs the Modbus TCP gateway option. Use Reconfigure to change the type or the port. This notice clears when a local read succeeds.

logger_s5_closed.title: S5-WiFi-ST stopped serving Modbus TCP
logger_s5_closed.description: Port 502 is closed. Solis does not officially support local access on the S5-WiFi-ST, and newer firmware closes port 502 and the web page while SolisCloud keeps working. Nothing in Home Assistant can reopen the port. Use Reconfigure to switch this entry to a Modbus TCP gateway on the inverter RS485 port, or use SolisCloud only. This notice clears if the port starts answering again.

update_clock.message: SolisCloud rejected the request time. The clock must be within 15 minutes of UTC.

update_timeout.message: SolisCloud did not answer before the timeout.

update_logger_busy.message: The local logger reset the session. It will be tried again after a pause. SolisCloud is used when a fresh sample is available.

update_logger_tcp_disabled.message: The S2-WL-ST closed port 502. Modbus TCP is disabled on this firmware. SolisCloud is used when a fresh sample is available.

update_logger_modbus_silent.message: The S2-WL-ST accepted TCP and sent no Modbus reply. Another client may hold the only connection. SolisCloud is used when a fresh sample is available.

update_logger_gateway.message: The Modbus gateway is not accepting connections. The last local sample is held until it answers.

update_logger_wrong_protocol.message: The logger answered with a different framing or slave than this entry expects. Change the logger type or the gateway mode.

update_logger_s5_closed.message: The S5-WiFi-ST closed port 502. Solis does not officially support local access on this stick, and newer firmware removes it. SolisCloud is used when a fresh sample is available.

options.s5_wifi_st: Solis S5-WiFi-ST (experimental, firmware may close port 502)
